mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates weakening labor market conditions, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when RSAFS is increasing.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when INDPRO declines > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase significantly, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when PAYEMS increases > 200k.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong demand in the housing market, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances when HOUST increases > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above the inflation rate (CPIAUCSL), it indicates a restrictive monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when FEDFUNDS > CPIAUCSL.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) growth slows down and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases, it signals stagflation, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances when GDPC1 growth < 1% YoY and CPIAUCSL > 3%.
